fato_historico: 1987: Aero Trasporti Italiani Flight 460 crashes near Conca di Crezzo, Italy, killing all 37 people on board.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you embrace resilience today. Just as a four-leaf clover represents luck found in the unexpected, remember that even amidst shadows and lessons from the past, your fire remains unquenchable. It is a good time to reflect on the fragility of life and focus your bold energy on cultivating gratitude and meaningful connections with those you love most.
frase_do_dia: Find the hidden clover of hope within the depths of your own brave heart.
significado_numero: A reminder of the strength found in collective human spirit and memory.
conselho: Consider pausing today to cherish your loved ones and speak words of kindness.
